heroSummary: Shawnee Mission students start the 2026–27 school year on different days depending on grade. Grades 1–7 and 9 start Wednesday, August 12; grades 8 and 10–12 start August 13; and Pre-K and kindergarten start August 14 after conferences on August 12–13. Thanksgiving Break runs November 23–27, Winter Break December 21–January 4, and Spring Break March 15–19. The district calendar lists May 25 as the last day for Pre-K and May 26 as the last day for grades K–11, with early dismissal on May 26.
heroSourceLine: Based on the official SMSD 2026–27 District Calendar, approved December 8, 2025

calendarNotes: SMSD uses different first days by grade. Grades 1–7 and 9 begin August 12, with early dismissal for grades 1–6; grades 8 and 10–12 begin August 13; Pre-K and kindergarten begin August 14 after conferences August 12–13. The official calendar lists 172 student days. Fall evening conferences cover grades 7–12 on October 14 and Pre-K–6 on October 15; spring evening conferences cover grades 9–12 on February 3 and Pre-K–8 on February 4. All Pre-K–12 students are out October 16 and February 5 for conferences. Pre-K does not attend December 18 and finishes May 25. Grades K–11 finish with early dismissal May 26. The accessible calendar supplies graduation times and host sites but does not identify a districtwide senior last day.

calendarFaqs.q: Do all Shawnee Mission students start school on the same day?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Grades 1–7 and 9 begin August 12, grades 8 and 10–12 begin August 13, and Pre-K and kindergarten begin August 14 after conferences on August 12–13.
